import sys, json, time
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
import verify
for nw in [1,2,3,8]:
    text = open('/tmp/maxw%d.json'%nw).read()
    import subprocess
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-B','/workspace/submission/main.py'], input=text.encode(), capture_output=True, env={'PYTHONPATH':'/workspace/.deps:/workspace/submission','LD_LIBRARY_PATH':'/workspace/native','PATH':'/usr/bin:/bin'})
    t0=time.time()
    try:
        verify.check(text, p.stdout.decode()); print(nw, 'verify ok', round(time.time()-t0,2), 'bytes', len(p.stdout))
    except verify.Bad as e:
        print(nw, 'FAIL', e)
